title: The Nightingale
summary: A rich man keeps a singing bird until a strange metal bird arrives.
coverScene: A tiny real bird sits on a large green leaf next to a shining golden mechanical toy under the soft moon.

sentences.text: Long ago, a great man lives.
He lives in a big house.
His house has a white floor.
The floor goes to a green place.
A little living being makes music there.
Many people come to hear it.
The man reads a book.
He asks men to bring the living being.
The living being makes good music.

They keep the living being in that small room.

The real living being sits on a tree part.
It makes a good sound.
End goes away from the room.
The man feels strong again.
He gives thanks to the living being.
He is very pleased at home.
